change: Removed oblique secondary (External Obliques + Internal Obliques): obliques are not meaningfully activated on a machine standing hip abduction — the machine limits stabilizer demand and there is no evidence of significant oblique recruitment for this movement. Added Gluteus Maximus to secondary under glutes bucket: the stance-leg glute maximus acts as a stabilizer during unilateral standing abduction, supported by EMG research on standing hip abduction patterns.

Removed Gluteus Maximus secondary: research shows the glutes work only isometrically to seat the pelvis on adduction machines, which does not constitute meaningful assist/stabilization warranting inclusion. Gracilis and Pectineus (true synergists) have no allowed mapping in the system. Secondary left empty to avoid inflation.
No changes. Primary Gluteus Maximus, secondary Hamstrings and Lower Back (Erector Spinae) are well-supported by EMG research on hip extension exercises.

Added Rotator Cuff as secondary (Lats bucket): per CLAUDE.md rules all pulling exercises must include Rotator Cuff secondary. Research confirms rotator cuff stabilizes the shoulder joint during overhead pulling movements. The original data omitted this required entry.

No changes. Both chest heads (Sternal + Clavicular) appropriate for neutral horizontal press. Anterior Deltoids and Triceps Brachii as secondary are well-supported by research on seated chest press biomechanics.
